exclusion_detail: Liposomal anti-GM3 cancer vaccine candidates: GM3 sialylated oligosaccharide antigen conjugated to alpha-GalCer or lipid anchors (glycolipid/carbohydrate vaccine constructs, then liposome formulation and immunology). Complex oligosaccharide-glycolipid conjugates are far beyond a 4-step small-molecule route.

lead.label: GM3-alphaGalCer (covalent) / GM3-betaGalCer (lipid anchor)
lead.why: Abstract: 'betaGalCer is an exceptionally optimized lipid anchor, which enables the noncovalent vaccine candidate GM3-betaGalCer/alphaGalCer to evoke a comparable antibody level to GM3-alphaGalCer.' No single best compound is a small molecule.
